subject: English
question_text: Complete the following passage using suitable connectors:
stimulus: ⎯⎯ The greatness of a book depends (a) on the accountability among the readers. If we read a ⎯⎯ book only once, we cannot discover many things in it. (b) basing on one reading, we cannot judge the standard of a book. (c) ⎯⎯ a book is praised highly, we have no doubt about the greatness of the book. (d) ⎯⎯ , by the first reading, we may not understand a book. (e) ⎯⎯ if it is read more than once, we can understand the greatness of the book easily.
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Rajshahi Board-2020 (Board Question With Solution)
